company.name: Firebolt
company.shortDescription: Firebolt is a cloud data warehousing platform that allows users to streamline their analytics and access to insights.
company.description:
Firebolt is the cloud data warehouse for builders of next-gen analytics experiences. Combining the benefits and ease-of-use of a modern architecture with sub-second performance at terabyte scale, Firebolt helps data engineering and dev teams deliver data applications that end-users love.

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-native data warehousing platform designed for sub-second SQL query performance, high concurrency, and elastic scaling to support AI and analytics workloads.
productsAndServices.name: Firebolt Cloud Data Warehouse

productsAndServices.description: A free, self-hosted version of Firebolt’s query engine that runs production-grade SQL queries locally or in any environment via Docker.
productsAndServices.name: Firebolt Core

productsAndServices.description: A data ingestion service that enables rapid, scalable, and cost-effective loading and transformation of data into Firebolt using SQL and integrations with popular tools.
productsAndServices.name: Fast Data Ingestion

productsAndServices.description: A multi-layered security framework for Firebolt’s cloud data warehouse that includes encryption, access control, identity management, and compliance features.
productsAndServices.name: Cloud Data Warehouse Security

productsAndServices.description: A collaborative environment for data engineers, analytics engineers, developers, and DevOps to manage data lifecycle, security, governance, and SQL development.
productsAndServices.name: Firebolt Workspace

productsAndServices.description: A set of integrations connecting Firebolt with popular data visualization, transformation, orchestration, and application development tools.
productsAndServices.name: Firebolt Integrations
